caption:
"Once I figure myself out, I'll start." You've been saying that for years. The future version of you isn't coming — she was always your brain's way of saying "not yet." The Current Line stops the wait. We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this.

#overthinking #anxiety #selfimprovement #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: you're waiting for fixed you — she's not coming
